body: The van keys and first-aid kit share one cord. Green field flecks mark the keys. A strip of road tape seals the kit.
title: Van keys and first-aid kit

body: A coil of rope cut in equal lengths, work gloves, a measuring tape. The tape is stopped at the same mark each time. Looks like a perimeter around the vans, not a camp.
title: Rope, gloves and measuring tape
